scores.notes: Holmes striking at the bell-pull (left) and seated in armchair (right): both lean, clean-shaven, gaunt hawk-nosed face, dark swept-back hair with high forehead, similar middle age; right hair slightly fuller but no conflict.
Holmes with cane at the bed (left) and pulling Watson into the room (right): both tall, thin, clean-shaven, gaunt long face, dark slicked-back hair with high forehead, similar age.
Peter holding the net by the fire (left) and raising the lame man (right): both have curly dark hair going grey, short greying beard, weathered tan face, sturdy build, middle age.

Both show a sandy seabed path between teal-green curling wave walls under a cloudy daytime sky with red-tan sandstone cliffs and desert shore; right is the shoreline view as the path opens, left is inside the path - compatible.

Jesus on the cross (left, small and cropped at the forehead by the top edge) and standing in the boat (right): both have dark shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, similar skin tone and slim build; face detail on left is limited but no cue conflicts.
David with sling (left) and bending at the brook (right): both a beardless youth with short curly dark-brown hair, tanned skin, slim build, same teen age (and same brown tunic and bag).

Jesus on the cross (left, small, head bowed with crown of thorns) and standing in the boat (right): both have dark brown shoulder-length hair, dark full beard, lean build and similar skin tone; left face is small but cues agree.

Both show a brown seabed path cut through dark teal sea under a dark stormy night sky with rocky headlands behind; left is the opening seen from shore with low wave walls, right is inside the path with much taller walls - walls differ in height but the place and time of day are compatible.

Jesus standing on the water (left, distant) and standing in the stern (right): both have long dark hair past the shoulders, dark beard, slim build (and the same blue mantle over pale tunic); left figure is small and dim but cues agree.

Moses with staff leading the crowd (left) and raising the staff on the rock (right): both an old man with white hair, long white beard, tan skin, same staff and dark cloak over pale robe; right is seen partly from behind but hair and beard agree.

Moses striking the rock (left) and facing the sea (right): both an elderly man with white-grey hair and full white beard, tanned skin, brown cloak over pale robe; right is seen from behind in profile but hair, beard and age agree.

Holmes tossing papers in the carriage (left) has slicked-back dark hair with a high receding forehead and a gaunt middle-aged face; the Holmes pulling Watson through the door (right) has a thick tousled curly mop over the forehead and a noticeably younger, fuller face - hair style and apparent age conflict, though both are clean-shaven and dark-haired.

David kneeling to be anointed (left, head bowed in profile) and after slinging (right, mid-distance): both a beardless slim youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin, same age, same rough brown tunic; right hair looks slightly shorter but no conflict.

Left is set on the railway platform and shows the house only as a smoke column and fire glow behind a distant clump of trees across flat fields; right shows the white burning house, gravel drive and rose bushes up close. The house and grounds are not actually visible on the left, so the place cannot be compared (left is also greyer daylight, right darker dusk).

Peter raising the lame man (left) and standing by the courtyard fire with hand on chest (right): both have curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grey-flecked beard, weathered tan face, sturdy middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Both are a small wooden single-masted fishing boat with a hanging lantern on a dark night sea with a moon behind clouds and a dark hilly shoreline; left shows the storm, right the calming as the texts ask - boat, lake and hills are compatible.

Both show a ridged grass lawn enclosed by a low stone garden wall with rounded clipped bushes, tall trees, card-soldier hoops in the distance and large mushrooms at the right edge under the same warm daytime sky; right has more mushrooms and wire hoops but layout is compatible.

Holmes raising the cane (left) is gaunt and older with slicked-back dark hair off a high receding forehead and hollow cheeks; Holmes examining the hat (right) has thick wavy dark hair falling forward, a fuller smoother face and looks a decade or more younger. Both are clean-shaven and dark-haired but hair style, face shape and age conflict.

Daniel facing the king (left) and being hoisted on the rope (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, lean tanned face, slim older build (and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case).

Peter standing in the courtyard (left) and the front figure with the net on the beach (right): both have short curly dark hair with grey, short grizzled beard, tanned skin, broad sturdy build, brown cloak with a net over the shoulder.

Peter leaping from the boat (left) and standing by the courtyard fire with hand on chest (right): both have short curly dark hair greying at the temples, short grey-flecked beard, weathered tan face, stocky middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Holmes tossing the paper ball (left) and tapping the pavement with his stick (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hawk-nosed with slicked-back dark hair off a high forehead, thin tall build and similar middle age.
David kneeling under the horn of oil (left) and with the sling (right): both a beardless teenage boy with short curly dark-brown hair, light tan skin, slim build, same brown tunic and shoulder bag.

Peter raising the lame man (left) and leaping from the boat clutching his cloak (right): both have short curly hair, short greying beard, tanned weathered face and sturdy build. Right is noticeably greyer (hair mostly grey vs dark with grey flecks on left), but it reads as the same salt-and-pepper middle-aged man rather than a clear dark-vs-grey conflict.

Left Jesus is clear: long dark hair, dark beard, blue-grey mantle over pale tunic. Right Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross at the top-right hilltop - only dark hair and a blue-and-pale garment can be made out, no face, so identity cannot be judged.

Moses holding the crook beside the priest (left) and striking the rock (right): both an old man with white hair and full white beard, tanned skin, brown cloak over pale robe; hair is a bit longer on the left but colour, beard and age agree.

Peter stepping out of the boat (left) and wading ashore in a pale tunic (right): both have short curly grey-streaked hair, short greying beard, weathered tan face and sturdy middle-aged build; right slightly greyer but the same look.

Peter standing on the bow (left) has thick dark curly hair with some grey and a dark grizzled beard, about fifty; the Peter diving from the boat (right) has short light-grey/white thinning hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older. Hair colour and apparent age conflict (right figure is fairly small, but the pale hair is plain).

Both show a hillside olive grove with low dry-stone walls, a lake in the distance and the same golden late-day sky; left is the dirt road with a tan flat-roofed house behind, right is beside the house on stone paving. The house reads tan-plastered with an arch on the left and grey cut stone on the right, and the right adds a white columned building, but land, water, walls, trees and light are compatible for road vs doorstep viewpoints.

Daniel standing among the lions (left, small) and being hauled up on the rope (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe over a pale tunic.

Peter in the left foreground of the courtyard with hand on chest (left) and wading ashore in a pale tunic (right): both have curly grey-streaked hair, short grey beard, lined tanned face and sturdy middle-aged build.

Daniel addressing the king (left) and standing among the lions with open hands (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build, same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Both show the same rocky muddy seabed path between towering dark teal wave walls under a moonlit stormy night sky with rocky hills at the far end; right adds a walled town on the far ridge but the corridor, water and night lighting match.

Both show the same brown planked single-masted fishing boat on grey-green choppy water under dark storm clouds with green hills on the far shore in daylight; right has the sky clearing as the text asks, and the sail is furled, but boat, lake and hills are compatible.

Daniel on the rope at the den mouth (left) and pointing before the king (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case.

Moses with arms raised seen in back-three-quarter profile (left) and the staff-bearing old man at the front of the crowd (right): both have white hair, full white beard, aged tanned face, dark brown cloak over pale robe and the same crook; left face is partly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

Peter in the left foreground by the brazier (left) and leaping from the boat with a net on his back (right): both have short curly dark hair going grey, short grizzled beard, weathered tan face, stocky middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Watson seated on the right of the carriage (left) and the bowler-hatted man with the doctor's bag being pulled into the room (right): both have a full brown walrus moustache, otherwise clean-shaven ruddy square face, stocky build and similar middle age; hat hides most of the hair on the right but nothing conflicts.

Holmes tossing the paper ball (left) and bent over the hat with a lens (right): both gaunt and clean-shaven with a hawk nose, hollow cheeks, swept-back dark hair off a high forehead and similar middle age; right hair reads slightly greyer-brown but the same style and face.

Moses raising the staff with water arcing (left) and standing with the crook beside the priest (right): both an old man with white-grey hair, full white beard, deep tan lined face, dark brown cloak over pale robe and similar build.

Both show a dark brick-vaulted cellar with a stone-flagged floor stacked with wooden crates and lit only by a lantern; left shows more arches, pillars and barrels, right a single low vault with a doorway, which fits a different viewpoint in the same vault.

Both show a rough grassy lawn bordered by clipped hedges and trees with giant mushrooms rising at the upper right, hedgehogs and card figures on the grass and the same warm daylight; left shows a stone wall and rounded topiary, right taller hedges, which fits another angle on the same garden.

David standing under the horn of oil (left) and stooping at the brook with sling and staff (right): both a beardless slim teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tanned skin, same rough brown tunic and shoulder bag.

Both show a grassy croquet lawn enclosed by a garden wall with large shade trees, hedges, card-figure hoops and hedgehogs in daylight; right is viewed from under a tree with more ridged turf, left from the open lawn, but the walled tree-ringed garden is compatible.

Alice in the armchair at the tea table (left) and drinking from the bottle in the hall (right): both a girl of about ten with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair held by a blue band, fair skin, round face, same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both are a walled lawn under an overcast sky, but the enclosure conflicts: left has a red brick wall with open orchard-style deciduous trees and no hedges; right has a grey stone wall with tall dark cypress/conifers and formal clipped hedge walls. Wall material and planting style differ, so it does not read as the same garden.

Moses with the crook looking up (left) and raising the crook at the rock (right): both an old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, tanned lined face, brown cloak over pale robe and lean build.

Daniel standing among the lions (left, small) and being drawn up on ropes (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with satchel over a pale tunic.

Daniel standing beside the fiery throne (left) and hanging on the rope above the den (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case.

Jesus standing in the boat (left) and on the centre cross in the background (right, small): both have long dark hair to the shoulders, dark beard, slim build and the same blue mantle over a pale tunic; the right face is too small for fine detail but hair, beard and build agree and nothing conflicts.

Right Peter is clear (stepping onto the water, curly dark hair going grey, grizzled beard). On the left about ten near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples stand round the fire and none is singled out as Peter; the likeliest candidate (net over shoulder, holding a staff) is small and looks darker-haired, so identity cannot be judged.

Moses seated on the stone between two helpers (left) and standing on the rock with arms raised, seen from behind in part profile (right): both have long white hair to the shoulders, a full white beard (visible in profile on the right), aged build, brown cloak over pale robe and the same crook; right face is mostly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

Moses leading the crowd with a staff (left, mid-size) and striking the rock (right): both an old man with white hair, full white beard, brown cloak over pale robe and similar build. Skin reads somewhat darker brown on the right than the lighter tan on the left, but the whole right scene is painted darker and hair, beard and age agree, so no clear conflict.

Both show a brick barrel-vaulted cellar with a stone-flagged floor, stacks of wooden crates along the walls, an arched passage at the far end and lantern light; left is tinted warmer and right cooler, but vaults, flags, crates and passage are compatible.

Alice standing before the bench, seen mostly from behind (left, small) and swinging the flamingo (right): both a girl of about ten with long wavy light-brown hair, fair skin, slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings. Left face is largely turned away, so the match rests on hair, age and build, which agree.

The floating cat head (left) is a warm brown/tawny tabby with yellow-amber eyes; the cat on the branch (right) is a cool grey/silver tabby with green eyes. Both are grinning striped tabbies, but fur colour and eye colour conflict beyond what the lighting change explains (Alice's hair and dress keep their colours).

Jesus standing on the water reaching to Peter (left) and standing in the boat with arm out (right): both have long dark-brown hair past the shoulders, dark beard, lean face in profile, slim build and the same blue mantle over a pale tunic.

Peter in the left foreground of the courtyard with hand on chest (left) and leaping from the boat clutching his cloak (right): both have curly grey-streaked hair, short grey beard, lined tanned face, sturdy middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Both show a sunlit hillside above a lake with a white flat-roofed village, the same white columned building, cypresses, olive trees and low cut-stone walls on sandy ground; left is the road outside, right the stone house terrace, compatible viewpoints of one place.
